heading: F# awaits JSON with a caller-owned context
summary: F# ordinary Task<BehaviorJSON> calls use an explicitly owned BehaviorContext with an empty Setup and its default same-origin browser transport. The Service keeps that context private and releases it and its signal in OnStop. Last changes only after the request resolves. A matching custom adapter takes precedence. This uses the Task/BehaviorJSON and owner-disposal contract qualified in compiler28. It does not claim F# typed HTTPClient injection, record/list results, ValueTask, async lifecycle or shared page providers. The browser omits credentials, bounds JSON and cancels pending requests when the owner is disposed. This reduced example still needs its own snippet and browser qualification.
